title: backend-patterns
summary: Provides TypeScript-oriented backend patterns for API design, data access, query optimization, caching, error handling, authentication, rate limiting, background jobs, and logging. Recommends choosing patterns suited to the complexity level.

title: next-upgrade
summary: Upgrade a project to the latest Next.js version using the official migration guides and codemods. Identify the current version, apply relevant migrations and dependency updates, then verify the upgrade with a build and development testing.

title: vercel-react-best-practices
summary: Provides React and Next.js performance guidance for writing, reviewing, and refactoring code. It prioritizes practices for async work, bundle size, server and client performance, rendering, and JavaScript efficiency.

title: next-best-practices
summary: Apply Next.js best practices when writing or reviewing Next.js code, including using the optimized image component instead of plain HTML image tags. The skill covers routing, server components, data patterns, rendering, and performance optimization.

title: scaffold-nextjs
summary: Guides the agent through gathering project details and scaffolding a Next.js turborepo with UI components, development tooling, and deployment setup. It specifies project structure, configuration, and several implementation constraints.

title: next-cache-components
summary: Guides implementation of Next.js 16 Cache Components, including cached, dynamic, and static content; cache lifetimes and invalidation; and migration from `unstable_cache`. It also documents the restriction on runtime APIs inside `use cache`.

title: documentation-lookup
summary: For questions involving libraries, frameworks, or APIs, retrieve current documentation through Context7 rather than relying on training data. Resolve the library ID before querying, select relevant documentation, and use the fetched information in the response.

title: frontend-patterns
summary: Use React and Next.js frontend patterns for components, state, data fetching, performance, forms, animation, and accessibility. Keep frontend example data generic and choose patterns appropriate to project complexity.

title: define-architecture
summary: Guides the agent to define TypeScript application architecture, including repository shape, module boundaries, request context, middleware, frontend boundaries, testing, and rollout. It also prescribes an architecture brief and validation steps before finalizing recommendations.

title: typescript-unit-testing
summary: Guides agents through TypeScript/NestJS unit-testing workflows for setup, writing, reviewing, running, debugging, and optimizing tests. It prescribes Jest testing practices, mock usage, coverage expectations, and a focused process for resolving failures.

title: gsap-react
summary: Guides agents to build and review GSAP animations in React using useGSAP, scoped refs, context-safe callbacks, and reliable cleanup. It also covers keeping GSAP execution client-side to avoid server-rendering issues.

title: taste-skill
summary: The skill directs the agent to build distinctive, responsive React or Next.js interfaces using specified design defaults, component conventions, and motion and performance rules. It also prescribes visual patterns and interaction states, and requires a preflight review of generated UI code.

title: nextjs-turbopack
summary: Guides Next.js 16+ development toward Turbopack and explains when webpack is an appropriate fallback. It also recommends version-aware documentation and bundle analysis for production optimization.

title: migrate-to-shoehorn
summary: Migrate test files from TypeScript `as` assertions to `@total-typescript/shoehorn`, using `fromPartial()` for partial data and `fromAny()` for intentionally incorrect data. Install the package, update imports, and run a type check to verify the migration.

title: web-component-design
summary: Guides the agent in designing reusable UI components and component APIs with React, Vue, and Svelte. Emphasizes composition, styling choices, accessibility, and component implementation patterns.

title: auth-implementation-patterns
summary: Provides implementation patterns for authentication and authorization, including JWTs, sessions, OAuth2, RBAC, and permission checks. Recommends security practices for passwords, tokens, cookies, rate limiting, and server-side validation.

title: forge
summary: Use Forge to build small, runnable prototypes that validate ideas, relying on mocks where useful and keeping work ready for handoff. Prioritize learning and working demos over production polish, and report the prototype’s status, findings, debt, and next decision.

title: tdd-workflow
summary: Follow a test-driven workflow by writing tests before implementation, running tests through development, and refactoring while keeping them green. Aim for at least 80% coverage across unit, integration, and E2E tests, with attention to edge cases and errors.

title: polyglot
summary: Guides agents through internationalization and localization work, including extracting strings, structuring translation keys, locale-aware formatting, ICU messages, and RTL support. It requires using the project's existing i18n conventions and producing a documented summary of the changes.

title: typescript-clean-code
summary: Use Clean Code and professional-practice workflows tailored to TypeScript, consulting the skill’s reference files before giving advice or writing code. Apply relevant rules and examples, follow task workflows, and cite the sources behind recommendations.

title: segment-cdp
summary: Apply Segment CDP patterns when implementing browser or server-side tracking and designing event schemas. The skill covers Analytics.js calls, identity resolution, and Protocols-based tracking plan enforcement.

title: api-design
summary: Guides the agent in designing and reviewing REST API contracts, covering resource URLs, HTTP behavior, response formats, pagination, security, rate limits, and versioning. It also provides implementation patterns and a checklist for endpoint readiness.

title: motion-canvas
summary: Guides agents through setting up Motion Canvas projects and creating TypeScript animations, with particular attention to Vite configuration and ESM/CommonJS interoperability. It also provides troubleshooting guidance for common setup and build issues.

title: design-an-interface
summary: Gather module requirements, generate multiple radically different interface designs in parallel, and present and compare the options before synthesizing a direction. Keep the work focused on interface shape rather than implementation.

title: accessibility-compliance
summary: Guides implementation and auditing of accessible interfaces, with emphasis on semantic HTML, keyboard access, screen-reader support, and inclusive user preferences. Includes React and TypeScript patterns for common accessible components.

title: artisan
summary: Guides frontend work toward production-quality React, Vue, and Svelte components with TypeScript, accessibility, and explicit state handling. Defines workflow, approval boundaries, handoffs, and required deliverables.

title: bolt
summary: Bolt directs the agent to identify measurable performance improvements, follow a profiling-to-presentation workflow, and document their impact. It also sets limits on implementation, optimization scope, and when to ask for confirmation or hand off work.

title: web-artifacts-builder
summary: Guides the agent to initialize a React frontend project, develop a multi-component web artifact, bundle it into a single HTML file, and share it with the user. It recommends postponing optional visual testing until after presenting the artifact, unless testing is requested or issues arise.

title: design-system-creation
summary: Guides the agent through creating or refactoring a distinctive design system, from documenting its aesthetic to building tokens, typography, components, motion, and loading states. It favors custom visual choices and reusable design-system primitives over default styles.

title: web-design-builder
summary: Guides the agent to gather web-design requirements, create responsive and accessible HTML/CSS/JavaScript designs, and verify them with Playwright MCP when available. It also specifies what files, verification results, and guidance to deliver to the user.

title: tripadvisor-content-api-automation
summary: Automate TripAdvisor content API tasks through Rube MCP and Composio. Discover current tool schemas, verify the TripAdvisor connection, and follow the skill’s execution, session, and pagination guidance.

title: openapi-spec-generation
summary: Guides agents in creating and maintaining OpenAPI 3.1 specifications from design or code, validating API contracts, and generating SDKs and documentation. Includes patterns for reusable schemas, API descriptions, security, versioning, and validation tools.

title: asin-data-api-automation
summary: Automates Asin Data API tasks through Rube MCP by discovering current tool schemas, checking the API connection, and executing the discovered tools. It also specifies session, memory, schema, and pagination practices.

title: onboarding-ux
summary: Audit a web app from a new user’s perspective, then create onboarding guidance and code to address the gaps. Deliver the audit and generated materials in the specified artifact locations, matching the project’s existing patterns.

title: openui
summary: Guides agents in building generative UI apps with OpenUI and OpenUI Lang, including scaffolding, component libraries, prompts, rendering, and debugging. It also specifies how to fetch and handle OpenUI documentation and how to structure OpenUI Lang output.

title: gender-api-automation
summary: Automate Gender API operations through Rube MCP by discovering current tool schemas, checking the connection, and executing schema-compliant calls. Reuse workflow sessions and handle pagination until results are complete.

title: judge
summary: Use the Codex review CLI to review PRs, pre-commit changes, and commits, then assess findings for correctness, security, intent alignment, consistency, and test quality. Produce evidence-based reports with severity classifications and recommended remediation routes, without modifying code.

title: vibe-security
summary: Apply secure-by-default practices when building or reviewing web applications, protecting access, user data, inputs, outputs, and common application attack surfaces. Choose restrictive security options while preserving functionality.

title: apify-automation
summary: Use the Composio Apify integration to run Actors, retrieve and manage datasets, create reusable tasks, and inspect runs and logs. Check Actor-specific input requirements and use pagination or asynchronous runs when appropriate.

title: fastapi-templates
summary: Guides creation of structured FastAPI backend projects using async patterns, dependency injection, repository and service layers, authentication, and testing examples. Includes templates for API endpoints, database access, and user management.

title: currents-api-automation
summary: Automates Currents API operations through Rube MCP. It requires discovering current tool schemas, checking the connection, and following the returned schemas and workflow guidance when executing tools.

title: coding-standards
summary: Applies cross-project conventions for readable, maintainable code, including simplicity, reuse, and avoiding unnecessary complexity. It is a baseline rather than a source of framework-specific patterns.

title: shadcn-ui
summary: Guides agents through selecting, installing, and customizing shadcn/ui components in themed React projects. It emphasizes dependency order, semantic theme tokens, and assembling components into common UI patterns.

title: radar
summary: Add and refine tests, diagnose flaky behavior, and improve coverage while preserving product behavior. Follow the project’s existing testing conventions and verify changes with tests and relevant references.

title: navigator
summary: Navigator completes browser-based tasks using Playwright and Chrome DevTools, collecting data and evidence while monitoring errors. It emphasizes explicit waits, validation, safe credential handling, and reproducible execution reports.

title: api-ninjas-automation
summary: Automates API Ninjas operations through Rube MCP by discovering current tool schemas, checking the API Ninjas connection, and executing schema-compliant tools. It also specifies session reuse, memory parameters, and pagination handling.

title: microsoft-clarity-automation
summary: Use the Composio Microsoft Clarity integration to export recent analytics data segmented by dimensions such as device, browser, source, country, or URL. Help users configure the integration and understand its export limits and available breakdowns.

title: firecrawl-automation
summary: Use the Composio Firecrawl integration to scrape pages, crawl sites, extract structured data, batch-process URLs, map website structures, and manage jobs. Keep requests scoped and validate asynchronous or nested results.

title: claude-native-claude-api
summary: Guide the agent in building, debugging, and migrating Claude API applications using Anthropic SDKs and documented API patterns. Apply the skill’s defaults for model choice, thinking, streaming, and prompt caching, and consult the relevant language-specific and shared documentation.

title: trace
summary: Analyze real user-session data to identify persona-specific behavior patterns, frustration signals, and journey breakdowns. Turn findings into evidence-based reports and actionable recommendations while protecting user privacy.
